Funding has been insufficient. Moving the research to Aegis VII is only aggravating the problem. I understand the pressure to relocate the project outside the reach of the oversight committees, but this has only inflated our resource requirements.

We are on the verge of cracking the replication code we extracted from the Black Marker. It would be a shame to come this far and have to scrap the project.

...

The continued financial infusion over the years has been appreciated and I'm pleased to share the results with you today. While some of our material fabrications are approximations of substances foreign to us, we have completed the internal workings of the device. One obvious difference between our replica and the original is the reddish hue. I assure you this is purely a cosmetic difference not indicative of a flaw.

The device, when activated, began to emit a highly complicated rhythmic pattern across a wide band of frequencies - from actual sound waves through the electromagnetic spectrum to alpha, delta and theta brain waves. It seems mostly inert and harmless aside from some slight interference with communication equipment.

We are proceeding with the final construction.

...

We've run into a disturbing but fascinating find. In re-creating the DNA instructions gleaned from the Black Marker, we've managed to create a recombinant microbial life form. It seemed dormant at first, even when placed in a bath of rich nutrients. Were it not for Dr. Clifton's poor hygiene, we might have deemed the attempt a failure. Fortunately for us, he had not fully decontaminated himself before working with the sample and managed to contaminate it with some dead skin cells. Suddenly, the microbes jumped into action! Recombination happened almost instantly and the sample began self-replicating and mutating before our eyes.

...

More confounding results from our research: Today, as we moved what we're now calling the Red Marker, we had to pass by the cellular lab area. The scientists working at the time complained about interruptions in the necrotic flesh experiments. As it turns out, the field generated by the Marker creates a "dead space" around itself that forces the recombination effect into dormancy.

...

I apologize for the setback relayed in the last report. The macro-scale infection has been contained with a minimal loss of life. The newly recombinated doctors are now quarantined for further study.

...

Many of the scientists have been complaining of headaches and we are all having difficulty sleeping for more than an hour at a time. We suspect a problem in the ventilation system. The maintenance team reported finding a build-up of some kind blocking the airways.

...

The organic mass continues to expand and take over the complex. The recombinated nightmares now move freely through the corridors. My remaining crew is hastily constructing a transmitter for the Marker in an attempt to broaden the signal it is emanating. Dr. Foster said the idea came to him in a vision. Our hope is to use the signal to keep the unchecked infection from spreading to the landing area. There is little time remaining! You must send help as quickly as possible! Our lives are in your hands.

english: Doctor... Terrence... there will always be risk when the stakes are high. And here, they're enormous. It could change everything.
translation: 박사…테런스… 커다란 변화에 위험이란 항상 있는 법이야.이번엔 너무나도 거대해.모든 게 달라질 거야.

english: This is mutiny! You'll all be tried for mutiny! Kyne, make them listen to reason!
The Marker must be delivered to the church! Terrance, please...

Captain's log, personal. I want to set the record straight. By the time this log is heard, my actions will have been vindicated. I'm a Unitologist. By now, it's probably no secret that we shouldn't be in this star system. Just another illegal mining job for the company... That is until the colony found the Marker. That was when the Church took an interest, and chose me to lead this pilgrimage. They also ensured many of the mission crew were devout. My primary instruction was to get the Marker up from the colony and on board the ship. Dr. Kyne, the CSO, is an expert on the original Marker and was tasked with deciphering this new one. He says he's making good progress. My decision to quarantine the colony is sound. They've got some kind of epidemic down there, and I can't allow it to infect the ship. Not with such a precious cargo. Not when we are so close! Planetcrack takes place tomorrow. We'll continue to decipher the Marker, and when we return home, we'll pass all our findings, and the Marker, to the Church. The government isn't going to cover this one up. Altman be praised.
translation: 선장 기록,사적인 것이다. 기록을 바로 잡고자 한다. 이 기록이 알려졌을 때에는 나의 행동이 옳았음이 증명될 것이다. 난 유니톨로지인. 지금까지 우리가 이 행성계에 있었다는 것은 비밀이 아니었다. 그저 회사를 위한 하나의 불법 채굴이었을 뿐… 콜로니가 마커를 발견하기 전까지는. 거기에 교회가 관심을 가졌고 이번 순례를 이끌도록 나를 선택했다. 또한 임무를 수행하는 선원들은 대부분 독실한 신자들이었다. 주요 지령은 콜로니에서 마커를 가져와 우주선에 싣는 것이었다. 최고책임자 카인 박사는 원본 마커의 전문가였고 이번 새로운 마커의 해독을 맡았다. 박사는 작업이 순조롭다고 말했다. 콜로니를 격리한다는 나의 결정은 타당하다. 저 아래에 있는 자들은 어떤 종류의 전염병을 갖고 있었고 우주선이 감염되는 걸 용납할 수 없다. 귀중한 화물도. 가까이 갈 때가 아니란 말이다! 행성채굴이 내일 시작된다. 우리는 마커 해독을 계속할 것이며 지구로 돌아가면 모든 결과물과 마커를 교회에 넘길 것이다. 정부는 이걸 은폐하지 못 할 것이다. 알트만을 찬양하라.

All right everyone, we're here.  Synching our orbit now.
Deep space mining is a lucrative business, Ms. Daniels. Aegis 7 is a gold mine, according to prospector's reports.  Cobalt, Silicon, Osmium... Now where is she? There she is. We have visual contact.
translation: 우주채굴이야 재미보는 장사지,켄드라.보고된 바로는 이지스-7이 금광이라더군.코발트,실리콘,오스뮴… 어디… 저기 함선이 보인다.

english: The USG Ishimura. Biggest Planetcracker in her class. And it looks like they already popped the cork.
Corporal, take us in closer and hail them.  And stay clear of that debris field. We're here to fix their ship, not the other way around.
translation: 하사,접근해서 신호를 보내.저기 잔해지역은 조심해.우리가 오히려 정비 받게되는 일이 없도록.

english: Yes, we know. Boost the signal.  More.
Alright, you heard the lady. Take us in. Let's see what needs fixing.
Hit the blast shields! Their guidance tether is damaged! Switch to manual, NOW!
NO! We can make it inside! Corporal, I gave you an order!
I just saved our asses, Ms. Daniels! If we had aborted at that speed and distance, we would have smashed right into the side of the Ishimura! Now settle down, and let's get to work. Corporal, report!
translation: 이정도면 성공한 거야,켄드라.그정도 속도와 거리에서 중지시켰다면 분명 아작났을 거야.그러니 그만 진정하고 작업을 시작하자.하사,보고하라.

english: All right, let's get some extra hands from flight deck to help out.
All right. We've still got a job to do. We're moving out.
Guess the power's down everywhere. Isaac, get over here and hack the door pad.
translation: 모든 구역이 정전인 것 같다.아이작,여기 문을 열어줘.

english: There should be a security detail in here.
That security console is still live. Isaac, log in and see what you can find. Kendra, get that elevator back online.
translation: 보안장치는 아직 살아있는데.아이작,접속해서 뭐든 찾아봐.켄드라는 엘리베이터를 복구하도록 해.

english: Then re-route the damn power! Look, if we all cooperate, we can figure this out a lot sooner. Let's get that computer display up, Isaac.
translation: 어떻게든 해봐야지…어이,서로 협력해야 문제를 신속하게 해결하겠지.컴퓨터 화면을 봐줘,아이작.
엘 리 베 이 터 복 구

english: The tram system's offline. Getting around is going to be difficult.
Automatic quarantine must have tripped when the filtration system restarted. Everybody relax...
Isaac, get the hell out of there!
Isaac, we ran into more of them on the way over here. Are you okay?
translation: 아이작. 헐,우린 오는동안 몇놈을 더 만났는데,넌 괜찮아?

english: Keep your voice down! Whatever they are, they're not friendly! And half the doors on the ship are locked because of the quarantine.
translation: 조용히 말해.저놈들이 뭐건 난 사양이니깐.격리되는 바람에 문 절반은 잠겨있단 말이야.

english: Now we have to get to the bridge, but first, we got to repair the tram system.
translation: 지금 브릿지로 가야되지만 먼저 전동차를 정비해야 갈수 있어.

english: If you listen to me, I WILL get you out of here alive. Now what's wrong with the tram?
translation: 내 말만 잘들어주면 살아서 나가게 해주지.지금 전동차의 문제가 뭐야?

english: No, we can't... but you can. Isaac, if I can get to the Bridge, I should be able to access the personnel files. You fix the tram and I'll help you find Nicole.
translation: 그래.우린 안되지만 아이작 너는 가능해.브릿지에 인사기록이 있어.전동차를 복구해.니콜을 찾게 도와주겠어.

english: Alright, we're onboard and heading to the Bridge.  Good work.
Whatever was in the flight lounge must have left.  That's lucky for us.  Isaac, get back to the Kellion and prep it for launch.  We'll find out what we can from the bridge and meet you there.
translation: 대합실에 있었던게 뭐였건 간에 없어졌으니 운이 따르는 거지.아이작,켈리온에 돌아가서 출발준비 해줘.우린 브릿지를 확인해보고 합류할테니까.

english: Your lack of confidence in me is duly noted, Ms. Daniels, but I have a mission to complete and that's exactly what I am going to do.  With or without you.  Do we understand each other?
translation: 나를 불신하다는건 알아,켄드라.하지만 난 혼자서라도 완수해야만 하는 임무가 있으니 서로 이해해주는게 어때?

english: Isaac, we made it to the Bridge.  It's a nightmare up here.  No survivors.  We're going to try and get to the Command computer.  Wish us luck.
translation: 아이작.우린 지금 브릿지야.이건 악몽이야.생존자가 전혀 없어.일단 중앙컴퓨터에 접속해 볼테니까 기도나 해.

english: What the hell is happening down there?! What happened to the shuttle?
Just let me think! Can you access the Command computer?
Dammit! Isaac. I'm sending the tram back to your location. Get to the Medical Deck and find that RIG as fast as you can.
translation: 젠장!아이작.전동차를 돌려보낼게.의료실로 가서 서둘러 선장의 RIG를 찾아.

english: Holy shit! Come on, get out of here!
Isaac? Are you there? We were attacked! Kendra's gone! One minute she was there, then... I can't believe I lost her. We can still do this. Get me the Captain's RIG codes and we'll find Nicole.
translation: 아이작,들려?공격당하는 바람에 켄드라를 놓쳤어.분명 같이 있었는데,젠장.어떻게된 일이지…아직 포기하면 안돼.선장의 암호를 가져와.니콜도 찾게 될거야.

english: God, communication is useless in all this static...
Alright, that thermite you picked up should be able to melt through the barricade.  Use the shock pad to ignite it. Hope I can hold this position.  I can hear something big moving out there.
translation: 좋아.입수한 고열폭약으로 방어벽을 녹여버릴수 있을거야.점화는 충격기로 하면돼.난 그냥 여기 있고 싶어.밖에서 뭔가 엄청난게 움직이는 소리가 들리거든.

english: Great, you got a shock pad. Combine that with the thermite at the barricade to destroy it. Shit, I can hear more coming.  Moving through the vents.  Stay safe, Isaac.
translation: 좋았어,충격기를 찾았군.그걸 폭약과 조합해 방어벽을 날려버리는 거야.젠장!더 가깝게 들린다.환기구를 통해 움직이고 있어.몸조심해,아이작.

english: Okay, you're through.  Should be clear from there to the morgue. Remember, the codes are on the captain's body.
translation: 좋아,통과했군.영안실까지는 괜찮을 거야.명심해,코드는 선장의 시체에 있단걸.

english: That was Nicole, right? I can't tell from here when that log was made... I'm sure she's around here somewhere.
translation: 방금 니콜이었나?언제 기록한 건지는 모르지만…분명 니콜은 여기 어딘가 있을거야.

english: Codes received, and they look good. Thank god.  I'll start accessing the Captain's records right now. Head to the tram station, and I'll contact you there. I'm going to find out what the hell happened to this ship...
translation: 코드를 받았다.괜찮아 보이는군.천만다행이야.당장 선장의 기록에 접속을 시작하겠다.정거장으로 가.나도 거기서 합류하겠다.무슨 끔찍한 일이 있었는지 알아봐야 겠어…

english: Isaac! Somehow one of them found a way down to the Captain's Nest! I managed to contain it in a damaged escape pod.
translation: 아이작!한놈이 선장실 통로를 용케 알아냈더군.일단 놈을 망가진 탈출포드에 가둬놨어.

english: Lifting the executive lockdown now... I found the deck logs...

Whatever is happening around here, it came from the planet when they cracked it open.  It spread to the colony, and reached the ship. Isaac, this isn't an infection. It's some form of alien life! Shit! We've got bigger problems. The ship's engines are offline and our orbit is decaying! Get over to the Engineering deck asap, while I stay here and figure out what the problem is.
translation: 여기 발생한 일이 뭐였건 이놈들은 행성에 발을들인 순간부터 침입했었어.콜로니에 퍼지고선 함선까지 왔던거야.아이작,이건 감염체가 아니야.어떤 외계생명체라구!빌어쳐먹을!일이 점점 커지는군.엔진에 문제가 생겨서 함선이 궤도를 벗어나고 있다!서둘러 엔진실로 가.난 여기서 정확한 문제를 알아볼테니까.

english: Isaac, we've got two problems, and we're working on borrowed time here! First, there's no fuel in the engines.  Second, the gravity centrifuge is offline... which means there's a couple of trillion tons of rock pulling us down.  I need you to get that centrifuge operational, refuel the main engine and fire it up so I can stabilize the ship's orbit.
translation: 아이작!두가지 문제가 생겼다.게다가 시간이 없어!우선 엔진에 망할 연료가 없다.또 중력 원심분리기가 작동하지 않는다… 엄청난 무게의 바위덩어리들이 우릴 끌어내린단 소리야.원심분리기를 작동시키고 엔진에 연료를 공급해서 점화시켜야 한다.그래야 궤도를 안정시킬 수 있어.

english: Whatever you did, it's working Isaac! I have a fuel reading. It's only a quarter full, but that's enough to restore orbit once you bring the engines online... What the hell? False alarm.  Thought I saw something.
translation: 어쨌든 해냈군,작동하고 있어,아이작.눈금을 봐선 절반도 안되지만 엔진을 가동하고 궤도를 회복하기엔 충분한 양… 뭐지?경보가 잘못 울렸나.뭔가 본것 같았는데.

english: You're doing great, Isaac! Centrifuge and gyros are both a hundred percent and stabilized. Now get out of there and focus on the engine. I don't know how much time we have left.
translation: 정말 잘했어,아이작!원심분리기와 회전축 모두 100% 안정되었어.이젠 거기서 나와 엔진을 주시해.남은 시간이 얼마나 있을지 모르겠어.

english: It's working! We're online and functional! Finally some good news. Get a tram to the bridge, Isaac. I'm going to take us back into a geostationary orbit.
translation: 작동한다!기능에도 문제는 없어!이제야 좋은 소식이군.전동차를 타고 브릿지로 가,아이작.난 함선을 다시 정지궤도로 돌릴테니까.

english: Goddammit.  I'll start working on it from here.  Isaac, meet me at the Bridge.  You can do more good here than I can.
translation: 빌어쳐먹을!여기서 작동시켜 보겠다.아이작,브릿지에서 만나자.여기선 나보단 네가 적임이지.

english: Isaac, come in. Kendra's right, the ADS is completely shot. I'll need your help to fix this. Kendra, if you can hear me, see if you can get into the ship reports. It sounds like you have better access from there.
translation: 아이작.응답해.켄드라가 말한대로야.ADS는 완전히 정지됐어.복구하려면 도움이 필요하다.켄드라,듣고있다면 함선보고서를 찾아봐.거기선 접속이 쉬울거야.

english: I don't know anything about that.  It's referenced in the captain's records.  They brought it up  from the planet...
translation: 난 아무것도 모른다.선장의 기록에도 나와있었잖아.그자들이 행성에서 마커를 끌어올렸다고…

english: In cargo.  They think it's of alien origin.  But I don't know what the hell it is.
translation: 화물실이야.그자들은 외계인의 물건이라 생각하지.난 그딴게 뭔지 모르지만.

english: Back off.  I am not the bad guy here.  We're all shaky right now.  You're going to have to trust that I don't know anything about it.
translation: 집어치워.난 나쁜놈이 아니야.지금은 우리 모두 불안해하고 있다.난 정말 아무것도 모른단 말이야.

english: We've entered the debris field! Get to the captain's nest. I'll explain everything later. Hammond out.
translation: 잔해지역에 들어왔다!선장실로 와.나중에라도 전부 설명해줄게.해먼드 종료.

english: Isaac!  Damn, you scared me.  This place is making me jumpy. Fucking asteroids coming through the roof... Look, I know Kendra doesn't trust me, but I don't know anything about a Marker or anything else.  This was supposed to be a repair mission, plain and simple. This mess is the Asteroid Defense System. I can fix these boards, but the main power routing is shot. You're going to have to re-route them manually through at least three junction boxes to activate the primary cannon.  Oh, but first you need to activate the Atrium elevators from Bridge Security. You can use them to get to the junction boxes.
translation: 아이작!이런,여긴 사람을 쫄게 만들어.빌어먹을 소행성들이 위로 지나다니고…맞아,켄드라가 나를 믿지않지만 정말 마커에 관해 아무것도 모른다.단순한 정비임무였어.이 개떡같은 게 소행성방어장치[ADS]야.보드수리는 가능하지만 주전원선이 죽었어.캐논이 움직이도록 최소 3개의 배선함 경로를 변경시켜줘. 아,우선은 브릿지-보안실에서 관제실 엘리베이터를 연결해야돼.그걸 타야 배선함에 갈수 있으니까.

english: Thought that one was dead when I sealed the pod.  These things don't die easily.
Okay, primary astrogation power has been re-routed. Look, I don't know about you, but...I think I'm seeing things...my head's pounding still...  I don't know.  Just stay sharp, okay?
translation: 좋아,항해장치 동력이 연결됐어.너에 대해선 잘모르지만…헛것이 보인단 말야…젠장할 머리가 아직도 지끈거려…모르겠어.방심하면 안돼,알겠어?

english: Control Systems junction box re-routed. I'm getting a reading! Almost there.
translation: 조종장치 배선함이 연결됐어.지금 읽고있는 중이야.거의 다 됐어.

english: Ship Systems junction box re-routed. I'm making some progress with the tracking grid...one of the cannons is giving me a hard time...keep moving.
translation: 시스템 배선함이 연결되었다.조금은 진전이 되고있어…캐논 하나가 애를 먹이긴 하지만…지금처럼만 해줘.

english: All right, we've got enough power. But the ADS cannon's auto targeting is down. I think it's a faulty data cable. I need you to aim the cannon manually until I can replace it. Take the elevator to the top of the ship, and head for the cannon pit.\n
translation: 좋아.전력은 충분하다.하지만 아직 자동조준이 안돼.케이블 문제 같은데.교체가 끝날때까지 수동으로 조준해.엘리베이터를 타고 꼭대기에 있는 캐논실로 가.

english: That's it, Isaac, you're in the pit. The cannon's a massdriver, so it should punch through anything flying at us.  Keep an eye on the hull's integrity.  Too many of those things get by and we're dead. I think I've almost got the system repaired. Just buy me a little more time!
translation: 그거야,아이작.캐논실이군.캐논으로 여기 날아오는건 모조리 격추시킬수 있을거야.보존수준을 주시해.너무 많이 당하면 우린 끝장이야.시스템 복구가 거의 마무리 단계야.좀더 시간이 필요해!

english: Nice shooting, Isaac! Auto targeting is now online and clearing a path to safe orbit! As soon as we're clear, I'll engage the autopilot again. Head to the tram station and I'll meet you there when I'm done.
translation: 사격실력이 좋군,아이작!자동조준이 복구되고 안전궤도권으로 회복되고 있다.안전이 확보되는데로 자동항해장치를 시작하겠다.정거장으로 가.끝나면 거기서 합류하겠다.

english: Will this never end?! Isaac, get to Medical and mix together whatever Kendra's come up with. I'm heading to Hydroponics. If I can slow it down, that might keep us breathing long enough to fight it.
translation: 잠깐 쉬지도 못하나?!아이작,의료구역에서 켄드라 지시대로 필요한걸 모아.난 수경재배실로 가겠다.오염을 지연시킬수 있다면 그놈을 공격할 때까지는 숨이라도 붙어있겠지.

english: Is anyone there? Repeat! Come in Isaac... Kendra, is anyone there?
I've reached Hydroponics. It's bad down here, really bad! ...can barely breathe! That organic matter is growing everywhere! My eyes are stinging... must be seeing things...
translation: 지금 수경재배실이야.제기랄,최악이야…숨막혀 죽겠어.염병할 놈들이 여기저기 퍼지고 있어.눈이 아파…헛것이 보이다니…

english: Whatever you're going to do, do it fast... Can hardly breathe in here...

Isaac... Good to see you  in one piece... Don't take... your helmet off... the air's rotten... I got a look... at it... it's huge... you won't believe it... shut itself in Food Storage...The crew that was on this deck... I think they're what's poisoning the air. They've been transformed... I saw one of them, bloated, swollen. They're poison factories...we need to take them out  while we can still breathe...
translation: 아이작…반갑구만.헬멧을…벗지마.공기가 오염됐어…말도 안되게 엄청난 놈을 봤어.식량저장고를 막고있어…여기 선원이었던…그놈들이 공기를 오염시키고 있는거야.변했어…한놈을 봤는데…퉁퉁 부풀어 올랐어.그놈들이 독의 제조공장이야…아직 숨이라도 쉴수있을때 전부 없애버려야돼…

english: Isaac! Isaac are you there? Thank god you're all right! I've been trying to reach you! Someone's been blocking my RIG signal remotely! That crash must have interrupted the signal block.
translation: 아이작,거기 있나? 무사해서 정말 다행이야!합류하려고 했지만 어떤 새끼가 내 신호를 계속 차단시켰어!충돌 때문에 이제야 연결된거야.

english: Surviving.  Barely.  I found some med supplies and patched myself up.  Listen. I'm calling abort on the mission. Fuck the CEC and fuck the chain of command. We have to get the hell out of here! I think I've located a shuttle on the crew deck. The flight log says it needs a new singularity core, but we can probably salvage one from the Valor. I can see the tail-end of it sticking out from the side of the Ishimura. I'm headed down there now to  find a way inside! I'll meet you there! Hammond out.
translation: 살라고 발악중이시다.알아서 치료도 했고. 잘들어.임무는 집어치운다.망할 CEC고 명령이고 지랄하시네!여길 떠야돼!승무원 갑판에 우주선이 있었어.비행기록에는 우주선에 특별한 코어가 필요하다고 했지만 밸러호에 하나쯤은 있을거야.이시무라 옆에 밸러호 꼬리 부분이 보인다.당장 가서 들어갈수 있는지 알아보겠어.저기서 만나자! 해먼드 종료.

english: Isaac? Good, you made it inside! Listen! I just found the munitions log for the Valor! I don't think their presence here is a coincidence! They're not on reconnaissance and they're not on patrol! This ship is prepped for war! They're on a seek and destroy mission! Do you hear me?!
translation: 아이작? 안에 들어왔군,잘들어! 방금 밸러호 군수품 기록을 찾았어!군함이 여기에 온건 우연이 아니야!순찰하던 것도 아니었어!이 우주선은 전투준비가 돼있어!수색-섬멸 임무중이었어!내말 들려?!

english: Isaac!  Over here!  I've been trying to reach you but my comm was out!  You got the singularity core...That's our ticket out of here. Get that core to the shuttle! Don't wait for me. Oh, fuck me. Aaarrgh!
translation: 아이작,여기야!합류하려 애썼지만 내 통신기는 맛이 갔어!코어를 찾았군… 그게 탈출 차표야.난 신경쓰지 말고 우주선으로 가!이런,개같은.아아아아-!

english: Hydroponics log, Dr. Elizabeth Cross reporting. I'm pleased to say that we're working close to maximum capacity at the present time.  All flora is healthy and thriving and food yield has created a surplus. I was going to pass the surplus on to the colony, but the Captain has given a no-fly order. I want to note my opposition to that order. Everyone knows they're in trouble down there, and  I don't see what denying them our surplus will achieve.
translation: 재배구역 기록,엘리자베스 크로스 박사 보고.현재 거의 최고수준으로 생산중이라 다행이다.모든 식물의 성장상태도 좋고 식량도 초과생산되었다.남는 것을 콜로니로 전하려 했지만 선장님이 비행금지령을 내렸다.그 명령에 반대하고 싶지만… 모두가 저 아래에 문제가 있다는 걸 알고있다.그래서 알수 있다.남은 식량이 그곳에 전해질리 없다는걸.

english: Hello? Hello! Security! Thank god. This is Dr. Cross, in Hydroponics. I'm trying to locate Second Engineer Jacob Temple! I can't get through to Engineering! Of course I know there's a ship-wide medical alert! That's why I'm trying to locate him! No, we're safe for now. But the tram is down, and we can't reach the escape pods. Hello? Hello?!
translation: 여보세요?여보세요!보안!오 감사합니다.재배구역의 크로스 박사입니다.보조 기술자 제이콥 템플을 찾고 있어요!정비구역을 지나갈 수가 없어요.모든 구역에 전염병 경보가 있다는건 알아요!그래서 그사람을 찾는 거예요!아뇨,지금은 괜찮아요.하지만 전동차가 고장나서 우린 탈출포드에 갈수가…여보세요? 여보세요?!

english: Hydroponics log, Dr. Cross reporting. Something huge just slammed into the hull, near Food Storage. It wasn't a rogue asteroid, I know what that sounds like. But it was big, and heavy. I'll report again when I know more.
translation: 재배구역 기록,크로스 박사 보고. 뭔가 거대한 것이 식량저장고 근처에 부딪쳤다.떠돌아 다니는 소행성은 아닌것 같은데 커다랗고 묵직해 보였다.더 알게되면 다시 보고하겠다.

english: Hello? Can anybody hear me? My name is Eileen Fisk, I just woke up in here and everybody was gone... I don't know what's happening... Why did they all leave? I'm going to try and find someone... If you can hear this, please come for me... I can hear scratching in the walls...
translation: 여보세요?내말 들리는 사람 없어요?저는 아일린 피스크.방금 일어났는데 모두 사라졌어요…무슨 일이지…모두 왜 떠난 거죠?누군가 있나 찾아봐야 겠어요…만약 누군가 이걸 듣는다면 제발 와주세요…벽안에서 긁어대는 소리가 들려요…

english: H-Hello? Who's there? Are you a doctor? Why has everyone... Wait, I know you. You're Harris! The prisoner from the colony! You killed that nurse... Help! Somebody help me! Please!
translation: 저-저기?거기 누구에요?의사? 잠깐,누군지 알겠어.해리스.콜로니에서 온 죄수.간호사를 죽이다니…도와줘요!누가 좀 도와주세요,제발!

english: Isaac, I'm tracking your position but it doesn't look like I can reach you.  This damn ship was\nnearly sheared in half.  I made it to the bridge...it's a mess here.  These poor bastards didn't stand a chance. I'm going to override all door locks so you can get to the engine room.  I'll try and catch up with you there.
translation: 아이작,계속 따라가고 있었지만 합류하긴 힘들겠어.우주선은 거의 두동강이 났어.브릿지에 왔지만…엉망진창이야.불쌍한 놈들이 반격할 틈도 없었군.문을 전부 개방하고 있으니까 엔진실에 갈수 있을거야.어떻게든 나도 엔진실로 가겠다.

english: The infection process is doing something strange to these soldiers.  They all had built-in Stasis units in their\nbody armor.  The infection is merging the Stasis unit into their flesh or something...making them move fast...real fast. Be careful.\n
translation: 여기 감염된 군인들은 뭔가 이상하다.방탄복에 감속장비가 내장되어 있었어.감염때문에 그게 피부와 융합되어 버린건지 아니면…이놈들 움직임이 빨라졌어…정말 빨라,조심해.

english: I've almost got this thing fixed!  Just a little bit longer!\n
Just one more minute and it should be fully operational!
(screams, grunts of pain as Hammond is attacked by and attacking and finally killed by,  the BRUTE)
Your weapons can't punch through that thing's armor! Shoot it in the back, Isaac!
translation: 그 무기로는 놈의 껍질을 뚫을수 없어!등 뒤를 노려,아이작!

english: Hydroponics log. This is Dr. Cross. It... It's hard for me to believe what I'm seeing here. This is crazy, absolutely crazy. I'm going to the Mining deck. I hear that's where survivors are gathering. Jacob... I'll wait for you there.
translation: 재배구역 기록.크로스 박사다. 이건…직접 보고있지만 믿을수가 없다.이런 미친,분명 미친거야.채굴구역으로 가겠다.생존자들이 거기로 모이고 있다고 들었다.제이콥…거기서 기다릴게.

english: Jacob, hurry up! We need to find a beacon!

translation: R I G 보 관 실
채 굴 용 엘 리 베 이 터
처 리 작 업 대 기 실
처 리 작 업 복 도
채 굴 구 역 복 도
채 굴 구 역 복 도

english: Isaac, be careful. Shooting them in the body didn't seem to work.  Go for the limbs, dismember them. That should do the job.
translation: 아이작,조심해.몸통공격은 효과가 없는것 같다.사지를 노려서 잘라.그게 더 나을거야.

english: Looks like the crew barricaded the door to the emergency wing.  You'll have to blow through it to get to the morgue. Get some thermite from Medical Storage, and a shock pad from Zero-G Therapy. Should be down the corridor.
translation: 선원들이 비상탈출구에 방어벽을 쳤어.영안실에 가려면 폭탄으로 날려버려야돼.의료보관실에서 폭약을 구하고 충격기는 무중력-치료실에 있다.복도를 내려가야 될거야.

english: As you know, the Ishimura is able to set its gravity locally.  Your grav boots will kick in when you enter a zero-g area.
translation: 알다시피 이시무라는 특정구역의 중력을 조절할 수가 있다.무중력 지역에 들어가면 중력장화가 능력을 발휘하겠지.

english: Isaac, you're going to have to cross the ship exterior to reach the ADS cannon.  Problem is, we're still getting bombarded by asteroids.  Look for cover or you'll get torn to pieces.
translation: 아이작.ADS 캐논실은 우주선 밖을 가로질러 가야돼.아직 소행성의 폭격을 받고 있는게 문제야.엄폐할 곳을 확보하지 못하면 박살나고 말아.

english: Mercer just flushed all the air out of the Medical Deck!  I've got to get back to the Security Station to seal the breach!
The air seems to be flowing again. That's a start.
By the way, Isaac. Be careful. I saw something out there, I don't know what. I only got a glimpse, but it was big. Really big.
translation: 그런데…아이작.조심해.밖에 뭔가 보였어.얼핏 보긴 했지만…정말 엄청나게 컸어.

english: Shooting them in the body didn't seem to work. Go for the limbs, immobilize them.\n

SCIENCE LOG
FROM: DR. KYNE, T. (CHIEF SCIENCE OFFICER)
ATTN: CAPTAIN MATHIUS, B.
Benjamin -
Further to our previous conversation, I ask that you delay bringing the Marker up from the planet for a day or two.
You know I'm as keen as anyone to study it in detail, and I understand your sense of urgency given the events on the colony, but that's why I ask--what's happening down there is just too unique, too unprecedented, to cut it short without proper time to study the causes and effects. 
In light of a discussion I had with Dr. Mercer, I'd like to meet with Drs. Sciarello and Welland planetside to get their observations.
- Terrence

translation: 헤 먼 드 의 죽 음
점 화 준 비 완 료

english: There is insufficient space on the hard disc drive to save data.  Please delete some existing data to save your progress.

MINING LOG
DALLAS, A. (SUPERVISOR, 2nd ENGINEER)

Planetcrack went smoothly from this end, although there do seem to have been problems planetside, and we've temporarily lost contact with the colony.

First rockball was extracted from the tectonic load approximately one hour after planetcrack, and has been processed, refined and smelted. 

Results have exceeded even optimistic initial estimates. Normal recovery is around 35% mineral, 5% fossil, 60% waste, but material from the first ball was 65% mineral (and 0% fossil, in line with expectations). 
That's 6.5 tons of ore from a 10-ton ball. Assuming it's not an anomaly, we've hit a motherlode.
Nicole is completely driven to return the Marker to the Colony.  If we can continue with Kyne's plan, and use it to trap the Hive Mind, we just might be able to survive this.  Together.
translation: 니콜과 함께 카인의 계획을 이어갈 수 있다면…

english:
CAPTAIN'S LOG
INITIAL INFECTION VECTORS
It's been less than an hour, but they've spread fast. Flight deck was the first to go, after the shuttle crashed. Now almost entirely overrun. We've lost at least half the Medical deck, and about a quarter of Engineering. No information yet from Cargo or Planet Ops, which suggests bad news.
This is not what I expected.
I need to secure the SOS Beacon to the asteroid.  Once the asteroid is launched, the beacon will clear the Ishimura's navigation array, and it will be able to broadcast a clear signal.
translation: 소행성을 발사하기전에 신호기를 먼저 설치해야 한다.

english: Complete Chapter 1 on any difficulty setting
Bring the Loader to the Shuttle

Practically overnight, our hope for humanity was renewed. Millions flocked to his conferences to hear him profess to know the way to a new beginning. We stared in awe at the evidence of the alien artifact that would change everything. And we did whatever he told us to.

We rallied against the government. We joined together in congregations to share his word. And we prepared ourselves for the future he said was coming.

Where were you when Michael Altman was assassinated by our government? It's the question of our generation, I suppose. It's certainly the day when everything changed for me... and the world.

...

The martyring of the scientist-turned-savior Michael Altman begat fanatical zealots and I was one of them. We birthed and maintained the tenements of a new religion, known now as the Church of Unitology. I was only a follower but I was suddenly part of the biggest social movement in history. The riots that followed and the crippling of our government made us realize we finally had the power to change things.

...

No one knows what is contained in the Black Marker. Some claim it contains a genetic string that grants immortality through gene therapy. Others say it contains the DNA of an alien life form. Even Altman confessed to not knowing exactly what it is for.

The Marker has been used to form the basic doctrines of the church. As claimed in the popular book, "Death is Only the Beginning," humans will learn that by death of their worldly spirit, they will be reborn in unity as a stronger, unending community. "Unity is forever."

...

Death is an important event in the journey of a Unitologist and seen as a necessary step to being reborn. The body is considered holy and it may not be cremated or be allowed to decay in the ground. The bodies are given to the church for safekeeping.

Where they are taken is unknown, but I have seen massive Unitology compounds on all of the major settlements I have visited. Curious, I asked around. No one would tell me what was housed inside, but I uncovered evidence of massive shipments of preservative chemicals being sent to the compounds on a regular basis.

It was around this time that my superior, Paragon Fontenay, brought me in for my first "soul cleansing".

...

Despite the headaches and the nausea that continued to plague me, I managed to sneak into the shipyard. I had almost regained full function of my legs and was able to make it into what appeared to be the nerve center of the operation.

What I discovered were ships, massive ships and lots of them. Stasis storage tubes lined each of the hundreds of exposed cargo bays. I couldn't see any of the bodies, but I knew what the tubes were for. What I couldn't figure out was why the church needed to transport so many suspended bodies in what looked like deep-space vessels.

Before I could investigate further, I was recaptured and the real "soul cleansings" began.

The chest of the corpse has started to expand, like it's taking a deep breath. Something appears to be happening under the surface of the skin. The body is convulsing - a yellowish briny liquid bursts from the mouth accompanied by choking noises. There's a crunching noise as the throat bulges and the jaw collapses. The head is splitting apart... reforming now into what appear to be a proboscis and feelers. The chest splits along the center now as the flesh stretches and expands outwards; the organs, bone and muscle bend inwards. The internal organs contort and reorganize themselves into an odd structure central to which is a massive bladder. The bladder is filling with a liquid, some of which can be seen spilling from the proboscis. I can only assume the two are connected.\n\n

The legs are quivering as the flesh peels away and meshes with the flesh from the chest region. There is a sudden snap halfway through the process as one leg bends backwards. More quivering now and the other leg has snapped at the knee. The changes appear to be slowing now... it starts to sit up, the body is convulsing, the legs flopping. It is trying to take its first step, uneasy at first... but now it is adapting quickly. A half-dozen steps and it seems to be perfectly at home with the new, contorted form.\n\n

The spattering on the glass is making observation difficult. It appears that Dr. Hogan's legs are elongating, somehow flaying themselves and now twisting with a mixture of his own internal organs into a single appendage, like some sort of tail. His face is contorted, his jaw clenching and unclenching... several jaw-like appendages are emerging from his every widening mouth. His mouth no longer appears able to accommodate the change... his head is splitting, seams bursting...\n\n

And almost instantly, he is perched on his hands, shifting his weight from one palm to the other. He's pacing, circling the room and... he appears to be watching me! He sees me! No, he's fixated on the ceiling now... Oh god no, he's leaping at the vent! With his powerful tail-like appendage, he's striking at the reinforced covering, trying to get it open! I must warn the others! Recording end!\n\n

Sorry, Isaac, I couldn't let him go through with it. I suppose I should thank him for finding the Marker. We even managed without help from the USM Valor... Thank you for helping me find it, by the way. My department's been looking for this place for a long time. See, what Kyne didn't know was, it was the government's mess to begin with. This whole planet is one big experiment.
translation: 미안해.아이작. 그놈에게 마커를 넘겨줄 순 없었어. 마커를 찾아준 건 고맙게 생각하지만 말야. USM-밸러의 도움도 없이 우린 해낸거야. 어쨌든 나를 도와 마커를 찾아준 건 고맙게 생각해. 우리 부서에선 오랫동안 여기를 찾고 있었어. 알아 두라고. 카인은 몰랐겠지만 정부의 혼란이 시작되었어. 여기 행성 전체가 하나의 거대한 실험장이지.

english: The Marker? This "divine relic"? Made by man.  They reverse-engineered it a couple of hundred years ago from the REAL Marker, a true alien artifact recovered on Earth.  They dug it up, studied it, and made it their own. Then they brought it to Aegis 7, and activated it.  And you've seen the result.  The stuff of nightmares. They sealed the system, and no one would have been the wiser.

But then CEC blunders in and starts tearing the planet apart.  The experiment was still alive.  Kyne was right about the Hive Mind.  The Marker would contain it...but that doesn't matter now, does it?  I have the Marker, and this entire system can go to hell. For what it's worth, you did a great job, Isaac. See you around... Or maybe not.
translation: 하지만 또 CEC는 실수를 범했고 행성은 엉망이 되기 시작했지. 실험은 아직 끝나지 않았어. 하이브 마인드에 관해선 카인이 옳았다. 마커는 그걸 억누르고 있었지만… 이젠 상관없지.안 그래? 마커는 내 손에 있고 모든 시스템을 없애 버릴 수 있게 됐으니. 그냥 내 생각일 뿐이지만 훌륭한 일을 한 거야,아이작. 그럼 또 봐… 아니면 못 볼 지도…

english: Is Kendra right...am I losing my mind...?  Nicole was dead this entire time.  A hallucination created by the Marker.  This whole time, it was the Marker pushing me to return it to the planet.  It's sentient...alive in some way.  And now Kendra has it again.  I've got to get back to the shuttle and get off of the planet before the chunk smashes into it!
translation: 운석이 떨어지기 전에 여기를 탈출해야 한다

How many times have you watched that thing? Guess you really miss her. Don't worry, we're almost there. You'll be able to look her up once we're onboard. Sounds like you two have a lot of catching up to do.
translation: 몇번이나 봐야겠어요?사무치시네.다왔으니 걱정말아요.도착하면 만날수 있겠죠.둘이서 할말이 산더미겠네요.

english: All this trouble over that chunk of rock.
translation: 저 바위덩어리 너머에 이번 문제가 모두 있죠.

english: Why is it all dark? I don't see any running lights.
You're going to need to boost the signal if their power is low.
translation: 저쪽 신호가 낮으면 우리가 신호를 올려야죠.

english: Never heard of a total communications blackout on one of these things.  You'd think with a thousand people on board, someone would pick up the phone--
translation: 통신이 전혀 안되다니 말도 안돼요.1000여명이나 승선해 있는데 누군가는 응답을 해야 정상인데…

english: It's a busted array like we thought. Sounds like they're having problems with their encoder. You get us down there and Isaac and I can fix it.  Forty-eight hours max.
translation: 예상대로 배열이 잘못됐어요.저쪽 입력기에 문제가 있는것 같아요.도착하면 아이작과 제가 고칠수 있어요. 최대 48시간 정도면.

english: Inside the magnetic field? Are you insane?! Abort!
What...? What the hell were you thinking?! Were you trying to get us killed?
Hold still, Isaac, I'm synching up everyone's RIGs with the ship. Okay, we're done. Clean bill of health for everyone.
translation: 모두의 RIG를 우주선과 연결중이니 기다려요,아이작. 이제 됐어요.특별한 이상은 없어요.

english: You didn't lose power to the port booster. You LOST the port booster! Unbelievable.
translation: 동력공급이 문제가 아니었어요.추진기 자체가 사라져 버리다니,대박이네요.

english: Seems like everyone was trying to pack in a hurry.
Yeah, well there's not. There's nobody here. I can't pick up any broadcasts.
translation: 그래요,그런데 없네요.여긴 아무도 없어요.아무런 안내방송도 없잖아요.

english: Please,  our plant life is fragile.  Decontaminated Personnel Only
Please,  our plant life is fragile.  Decontaminated Personnel Only
What was that? Did you hear that?!
I don't know! Something's in the room with us!
Come on... come on. Got it!
Run, Isaac! Get the hell out of there!
Isaac? Isaac! God, I can't believe he made it.
More what?! What the hell are those things? Is that the crew?!
You're crazy Hammond. You're going to get us all killed.

The data board is fried but there should be a spare in the Maintenance Bay. There's also a broken tram blocking the tunnel that needs to be repaired. Dammit,  everything is on the other side of this quarantine. We can't reach it from here.
translation: 데이터보드가 타버렸지만 관리구역에 여분의 보드가 있을 거에요.터널을 막고있는 부서진 전동차도 교체해야만 하고,헐-,전부 건너 편에 있는데 우린 격리당해서 갈수도 없어요.

english: That's it, Isaac! Take that board back to Tram Control and slot it into the computer array. That should get the tram system back online.
translation: 그거에요,아이작!전동차 조종실로 돌아가서 컴퓨터에 설치해요.그러면 시스템이 복구될 거에요.

english: Isaac, you did it! That tram was blocking the whole system.  When you get the computer online, you'll be able to call the tram from the control room.  Faster the better...I can hear something crawling around out there...
translation: 아이작,해냈군요!그 전동차가 시스템전체를 막고 있었죠.조종실 컴퓨터가 복구되면 전동차를 움직일수 있어요.빠를수록 좋아요…밖에서 뭔가 기어다니는 소리가 들려요

english: If we live that long.  You're out of your league, Hammond.  This is suicide!  We're going to die out here.
translation: 그때까지 살아있다면요.능력 밖의 일이에요,해먼드.자살행위라구요.우린 여기서 죽고 말거에요.

english: Just get us out of here alive.
That was our ride home... It's the only way off this ship...
It's no good. There's an executive lockdown of all primary systems. Without the Captain's authorization, I can't access them.
translation: 무리예요.모든 시스템에 상급보안이 걸려있어요.선장의 승인 없이는 접속할 수가 없어요.

english: Here he is. Captain Benjamin Mathius. Location... Medlab. Status... Deceased.
I can't access that information. Find the Captain and you'll find his RIG. With his authorization codes, I can crack this computer wide open.
translation: 정보에 접근할수가 없어요.선장의 RIG가 필요해요.승인번호가 있어야 컴퓨터를 사용할수 있어요.

english: Isaac? Can you hear me? It's Kendra... They attacked me...I ran for it...and Hammond just...he just disappeared.
Nice to see you're alive and well, Hammond.
I've barricaded myself in the computer core. I can hear them moving outside. But I don't think they know I'm in here--
translation: 컴퓨터 코어에 숨어있어요.밖에서 놈들이 움직이는 소리가 들리지만 내가 여기 있단걸 모르는것 같아요.

english: I can log into everything from here. I hacked the root, and found some reports from the colony. Even before they cracked the planet, the colonists were experiencing widespread dementia.  It seems to be related to some artifact they found on the planet.  Something called "the Marker."  I'll keep looking. I've got your location, and I'm going to unlock the door to Fuel Storage. You can get to the engine chamber from there.

Wait, wait! We're not safe yet. The ship's asteroid defense system is offline. On the way up, the ship's going to pass through a debris field thrown up from the planetcrack... We'll be ripped to pieces unless you restart it.
translation: 잠깐,잠깐!아직 안전하지 않아요.소행성 방어시스템이 꺼졌어요.이대로 올라가면 채굴때문에 생긴 잔해지역을 통과해야 하는데…방어시스템을 재가동하지 않으면 우린 산산조각 나고말아요.

english: When were you going to tell us about the artifact, Hammond?  This "Marker?"
Really?  CEC didn't know anything about it?  You're lying.
Isaac!  Impact on the bridge, right at your feet!  I'm reading heavy damage, but containment looks solid.    Life support is stabilized.  We've got to get the ADS working!
translation: 아이작!브릿지에 맞았어요.발밑을 조심해요.피해가 상당하지만 꽤나 튼튼하네요.생명유지장치도 안정적이고.ADS를 서둘러 작동시켜야 돼요!

english: Isaac, listen up. I've gone over the med-sci reports. These things are BIO-RECOMBINATORS. They take dead tissue, absorb it and molds it into new forms. One iteration seems to have the sole purpose of infecting corpses... The others, well, seem to be making corpses to infect. And that body tissue we keep seeing on the walls is part of it, too. I found a report that says it's a habitat changer.
translation: 아이작,들어봐요.의료연구 보고서를 방금 읽었어요.이것들은 생체-재조합체예요.죽은 조직을 흡수하고 새로운 형태로 변화하죠.어떤건 시체를 감염시키는 단일한 목적을 가졌나봐요…나머지는…감염시킬 시체를 만드는것 같은데.벽면에서 봤던 신체조직들도 이것의 일부였어요.보고서에는 [숙주변이자]라고 써있어요.

english: Wait! Isaac, Hammond...you're not gonna believe this. Oxygen levels are falling. Something's poisoning Hydroponics air production, and whatever it is, it's filling the deck up with that organic stuff. We're not going to have any air to breathe soon.  But if I understand these lab reports correctly, I think I can make a  poison to destroy it. Head to Medical. It should have everything you need.
translation: 잠깐만요!아이작,헤먼드…믿기 싫겠지만 산소가 줄어들고 있어요.뭔가가 재배실 산소공급을 오염시키고 있어요.그게 뭐든 유기물이 원인인 것 같아요.얼마 가지않아 숨도 못쉴거에요.하지만 내가 연구실 보고서를 정확히 이해한거라면 유기물을 제거할 독을 만들수 있어요.의료구역에 가면 필요한 전부가 있을거예요.

english: Shit, Isaac! I can smell the contaminated air from here. It's spreading faster than I expected! I'm trying to isolate it but it's not going to buy us much time! We have to get that thing off this ship! The chemicals you need are in the Chemistry Lab. I'll hack the door for you when you get there.
translation: 아이작!오염된 공기가 여기까지 왔어요.예상보다 훨씬 빨리 퍼지고 있어요.오염된 공기를 차단하려고 애쓰고 있지만 시간이 부족해요.근원지를 제거해야 돼요.필요한 약품은 화학연구실에 있어요.거기 도착하면 문을 열어줄게요.

english: Looks like someone has reprogrammed the door locks on this deck.  And recently, too. I guess we're not alone here, after all. Someone doesn't want you in this part of the ship.
translation: 그 구역 잠금장치가 최근에 재설정된 것 같아요.결국 우리만 있는게 아니란 거죠.누군가 아이작이 거기있는걸 원치않아요.

english: Someone keeps shutting down the door protocol. I've bypassed the lock! Go!

Now you need to find a DNA sample of the growth. According to lab records, there's an inert sample stored in the ICU.  A Dr. Mercer was apparently doing intensive research on it. I've been trying to contact Hammond but all I'm getting is static! Isaac, you've got to hurry!
translation: 이제 성장DNA샘플을 찾아야해요.중환자실에 비활성샘플이 보관되어 있어요.머서 박사가 거기서 집중연구를 했었어요.헤먼드에게 연락을 시도했지만 잡음만 들릴뿐.아이작,서둘러요!

english: That's it, Isaac! Now you just need to finish mixing the poison.

Who the hell was that?! Isaac, he's decompressed the entire deck and I'm being locked out of those systems! All the air has been vented into space! You should be able to bring it back online from the Security Station, but you don't have much time!
translation: 누구죠?!아이작,그자가 구역압력을 내렸어요.시스템에 접근할수가 없어요.공기가 전부 우주로 빠져나가 버렸어요.보안구역으로 가야 복구시킬수 있는데 시간이 얼마 없어요.

english: Hammond!  Where the hell have you been?
You've got everything you need to make the poison. Now get back to the Chemistry Lab!
translation: 독극물을 만들 모든 재료가 모였어요.이제 화학실로 돌아가요.

english: You're cutting out, Hammond! I'm going to try to switch over... Shit! I lost his signal! I'll continue scanning for his location! You have to get that compound mixed!
translation: 통신두절이었어요,헤먼드!연결을 계속 시도했지만…이런,신호를 놓쳤어!해먼드의 위치를 파악해볼테니 약품을 혼합해주세요!

english: Let's hope that poison works! Head back to the tram station, and get up to Hydroponics as fast as you can. Still no response from Hammond so be careful! There's no telling how contaminated that deck is.
translation: 독이 효과가 있기를!정거장에 가서 빨리 재배구역으로 가요.아직 해먼드가 응답이 없어요.그러니 조심해요.갑판이 얼마나 오염됐는지 알수가 없어요.

english: You can't kill it, Isaac! It's just going to keep regenerating!  Get out of there, run!
translation: 그건 죽일수 없어요,아이작!끝없이 되살아날 거예요.어서 도망가요!

english: Let's just  hope that's the last we see of that...thing.  I've managed to override Mercer's lockdown. There's a secondary tram station nearby and you can take to Hydroponics. Let's just hope there's enough time.
translation: 마지막으로 보는 거였으면…그걸.겨우 머서의 방해를 막았어요.근처에 정거장이 있으니 전동차로 재배구역에 갈수있어요.시간이 충분하길 기도해요.

english: Hammond! I thought you were dead! You need to get to cleaner air! You're not going to be able to help Isaac in your condition. Isaac, I'm scanning the area now. He's right, there's something really big in Food Storage, but I can't get a good scan. Monitor readings are off the scale. Be careful!
translation: 헤먼드!죽은줄 알았는데.신선한 공기가 필요해요.지금 상태로는 아이작을 도와줄수가 없겠어요.아이작,지금 거기를 탐색중이예요.맞아요.식량저장고에 잘 보이지는 않지만 엄청난 것이,화면에 전부 잡히지도 않게 커요.조심해요.

english: That's the door to Food Storage. But I can't override the integrity lockdown.  You have to destroy the pods to bring the air quality up.   Then you can go through and use the poison on the Leviathan.
translation: 식량저장고 문이예요.하지만 열수가 없어요.오염의 근원을 제거해 공기를 깨끗하게 해야돼요.그래야 그곳을 지나 레비아단을 제거할 독을 사용할수 있어요.

english: That's the last one, Isaac. There's a switch in Atmosphere Control to restart the oxygen recycling. Once the air's clean, you can get into Food Storage. Isaac, I've been reading these reports...the crew all began having mass hallucinations.  And...well, I just saw my brother on a security monitor.  And that's just not possible...
translation: 그게 마지막이예요,아이작.대기조절장치에 산소순환 재가동 스위치가 있어요.일단 공기가 정화돼야 식량저장고에 들어갈수 있어요.아이작,여기 보고서들을 읽어봤는데…모든 선원들이 집단환각을 겪었어요.또…이런.방금 보안 모니터에 동생이보였어요.있을수 없는 일인데…
유 니 톨 로 지 조 항

english: Dammit, the poison wasn't strong enough. It's still alive! Get in there and kill it, before it contaminates the entire ship!
translation: 이런,독이 약했어요.아직 살아있어요!우주선 전체를 오염시키기 전에 들어가서 죽여요!

english: Isaac, you did it! Hammond? Do you read? Oxygen levels are returning to normal.

Dammit! He's gone again! No sign of his RIG anywhere! It's up to us now. I've got a plan to get off this ship! I've located an SOS beacon on the Mining Deck. If you can get down there and activate it, we might be able to send a distress call.
translation: 이런!또 사라지다니.헤먼드의 신호가 안잡혀요.이젠 우리에게 달렸어요.여기서 벗어날 방법이 있어요.채굴구역에서 SOS장치를 찾았어요.거기 가서 작동시킬수만 있으면 구조요청이 가능해요.

english: Oh god.  I don't know how much longer that door will hold...

This may be our last chance of getting out of here alive, Isaac. There's an asteroid loaded up in the mining bay, waiting to be smelted. If you attach the SOS beacon to it, you can launch it away from the ship to make a clean broadcast. The beacon's  on the Maintenance sub deck. You can launch the asteroid from the control room. Damn, the control room is locked.  It looks like they keep an emergency access key on the Processing sub deck. Couldn't be easy, could it? I don't know how much more of this I can take.
translation: 이번이 여기서 살아나갈 마지막 기회일지도 몰라요,아이작. 채굴구역에 제련하려던 소행성이 있어요.거기에 구조신호장치를 설치하면 먼곳까지 송신을 할수 있을거에요.장치는 관리구역 보조갑판에 있어요.소행성 발사는 통제실에서 할수 있구요.이런,통제실이 잠겼어요.비상접속 열쇠를 처리실 보조갑판에 보관해둔 모양이에요.쉬운 일이 없네,안그래요? 얼마나 더 해낼수 있을지 모르겠어요.

english: That's the key, Isaac. It'll get you into the Control Room so you can launch the asteroid. Don't forget to attach the beacon first! I read another report on the colonist's dementia.  It seemed to start after they removed the Marker from the planet.  God knows how long it was down there.
translation: 그게 열쇠예요,아이작.이제 통제실에서 우주로 소행성을 보낼수 있어요.신호기 설치가 먼저라는거 잊지말아요!다른 보고서를 봐서는 콜로니인들의 정신이상은 마커를 들여온 이후부터 인것 같은데.그게 얼마나 오래된 것인지 누가 알겠어요.

english: Isaac! Hey, I lost your signal for a while. You had me worried... I see you've got the beacon, so head for the mining bay and attach it to the asteroid. I've been running trajectory calculations and if we launch soon, there's a good chance the asteroid can reach a safe distance to begin transmitting!  Still no sign of Hammond.  In his state, I can't imagine he's still alive...
translation: 아이작!아휴,잠깐 신호를 놓쳤어요.걱정하게 만들고…신호기를 찾았으니 채굴구역으로 가서 소행성에 설치해야죠.궤도를 계산해보니 금방이라도 발사가 가능하다면 통신 가능한 거리까지 보내기에 좋은 시기에요.해먼드가 아직 응답이 없어요.지금 상태에선 살아있다고 보긴 힘들지도…

english: Beacon's on it's way! All functions normal, and broadcasting wide band. Now we just have to hope somebody's listening.  I'll position the array receiver. I thought I saw my brother again.  He waved to me.  Like nothing was wrong. Okay, I should be able to leave this channel open... What? The comms Array receiver isn't responding! Isaac, can you get back to the bridge? We need that array online or we can't receive signals from anyone responding to the beacon!
translation: 장치가 움직여요!모든 기능도 정상적이고 송신도 제대로 되고있어요.이젠 누구든 들어주기만을 바라야죠.수신기를 설치해 둘게요.또 남동생을 본것 같은데.나에게 손을 흔들었어요.아무일도 없다는듯이… 됐어요.채널을 열어 둘수만 있으면… 어? 수신기가 응답이 없다니!아이작,브릿지로 돌아갈 수 있겠어요? 배열을 연결하지 못하면 누군가 응답하더라도 우리가 신호를 받을수 없게돼요!

english: Things are looking up! A military ship just shocked in! The USM Valor...I don't know what it was doing out there, but it must have gotten our distress signal.  We can't talk to it until that Comms Array is fixed.  I'm going to hack the door to Communications for you. Get in there and find the Comms Control Station.
translation: 죽으란 법은 없다더니!군함이에요,밸러[용기]호…저기서 뭘하고 있었는지는 모르지만 우리 구조요청을 듣고 오는게 틀림없어요.통신배열을 복구 못하면 저쪽과 연락할수 없어요.통신실 문을 열어줄테니 들어가면 조종장치를 찾아요.

english: Isaac, the door to Communications  is open. But I've been getting some weird feedback spikes on the local comms. I think someone's listening in on us, so be careful.
translation: 아이작,통신실로 가는 문이 열렸어요.그런데 우리 통신에 묘한 반응이 섞여 있었어요.누군가 엿듣고 있는것 같은데,조심해요.

english: That Comms Array is in bad shape.  We need at least six working dishes for a strong enough signal.   Make sure they're aligned symmetrically so there are no power gaps.
translation: 그 통신배열은 잘못됐어요.충분한 신호를 만들려면 작동하는 안테나가 적어도 6개는 필요해요.전기전달에 틈이 없도록 서로 마주보게 놓아야 돼요.

english: That's it, it's working! Get back to Communications and use the control panel to send our coordinates to the Valor!
translation: 됐어,작동해요!통신실에 돌아가서 조종장치로 밸러호에 우리 좌표를 보내요!

english: What? Isn't that the escape pod Hammond jettisoned? One of those things was onboard! No! No, this isn't going to happen! USM Valor! Come in Valor! Our signal isn't strong enough.  I'm going to open the blast doors to boost the signal.
translation: 뭐라구요? 그건 헤먼드가 버린 탈출포드 아니예요? 놈들 중 하나가 안에 있었는데!이래선 안돼! USM-밸러!응답하라,밸러호!신호가 약해요.방화문을 열어서 신호를 증폭시켜야 겠어요.

english: Shit!  Isaac, there's something big on the hull of the ship, directly above the Comms Array.  Something organic.  I don't know what it is, and I don't care.  We have to get the doors open to transmit to the Valor. You should have a clear shot from ADS cannon 48.  Get to the cannon and blow it out into space!
translation: 젠장!아이작,선체에 뭔가 커다란 것이 통신배열 바로 위에 있어요.어떤 살아있는 거예요.그게 뭐든 밸러호와 교신하려면 문을 열어야 돼요.48 ADS캐논으로 가서 그놈을 우주로 날려 버려요!

english: USM Valor, this is Kendra Daniels on the USG Ishimura, come in! Do not open the escape pod. USM Valor, this is Kendra Daniels on the USG Ishimura, come in! Do not open the escape pod! Dammit, respond!
translation: 밸러.여기는 이시무라호 켄드라 다니엘스다.응답하라!탈출포드를 열지마라.밸러,여기는 이시무라호 켄드라 다니엘스.응답해!탈출포드를 열지마! 이것들아,대답해!

english: Why did they open the pod?! Dammit...
Oh my god, It's heading right for us! Isaac! ISAAC! Get the fuck out of there! It's going to crash into the ship.
translation: 이런 지랄,이리로 온다! 아이작,아이작!당장 거기서 나가요!우리랑 충돌하겠어요!

english: Isaac, if what he says is true about the shuttle, we might have a chance of getting out of here. Head to the cargo bay and see if you can help Hammond...in his condition, he may not last long.
translation: 아이작,해먼드 말대로라면 빠져나갈 기회가 생긴거에요.화물칸으로 가서 헤먼드를 도와요… 지금 상태로는 해먼드가 오래는 못버틸거에요.

english: Isaac, I've lost him again! No signal from Hammond's RIG... Find the singularity core and get the hell out of there!
translation: 아이작,또 놓쳤어요!헤먼드의 신호가 사라졌어요… 코어를 찾아서 나와요!

english: The part you're looking for will be in the engine room at the back of the ship! I'm reading massive damage, so you may need to find an alternate route to get there!
translation: 코어가 있는 엔진실은 함선 후방이지만 파손이 심해서 그냥 갈수는 없어요.다른 경로를 찾아야돼요.

english: I just lost all of Hammond's vitals!  Is he dead?  Oh god. It's just us now, Isaac...
translation: 방금 헤먼드 생명신호가 사라졌어요!죽은거에요? 맙소사.이젠 우리 뿐이예요,아이작…

english: Is that it? You got it? Oh my god, you got it!  That's the piece we need. Get to the Crew deck!

Isaac, I've located the shuttle Hammond found. Shit! No good. That shuttle's brain dead. Someone removed the navigation cards, God knows why.  There's three of them scattered around the deck.  I'm downloading their locations. I can't access the doors from here, so you'll need a Crew Key.  If you can find those parts, I think we can get that shuttle operational again!
translation: 아이작,헤먼드가 말한 우주선을 찾았어요. 제길!이런. 우주선에서 반응이 없어요. 누군가 운항 카드를 가져갔어요. 기가 막히네요. 그 중 3개가 갑판 주위에 포착됐어요. 정확한 위치를 다운로드 중이예요. 여기서는 그 문에 접속할 수가 없어요. 승무원 열쇠가 필요할 거에요. 운항 카드를 전부 찾아야 우주선을 다시 가동시킬 수 있을 거예요!

english: Isaac, be careful with Dr. Kyne. A lot of what I've discovered so far has come from his records... the man has clearly gone insane. He might be unstable, maybe even violent.
translation: 아이작,카인 박사를 조심해요. 지금까지 찾아낸 박사의 수 많은 기록들로 봐서는… 거의 정신이 나간 사람 같아요. 불안정한 상태인데다 난폭해 질 지도 몰라요.

english: I don't know if Kyne is crazy or not, but we need that shuttle. Let's keep him on our side... for now.
translation: 카인이 미친 건 지 아닌 지는 모르지만 우린 우주선이 필요해요. 지금은 우리 편으로 하자구요… 지금은.

english: I restored power to the elevator.  Take it up to the Hangar Bay and get that Marker on the shuttle.  I'm heading up to the flight deck now. Oh god...I'm just going to run for it...wish me luck.
translation: 엘리베이터 전원을 복구했어요. 격납고로 가서 마커를 우주선으로 옮겨 줘요. 지금 비행장으로 갈게요. 오 이런! 도망가야 겠어… 행운을 빌어줘요.

english: Unprocessed employee detected. Welcome CEC employee...  Isaac Clarke...  to the USG Ishimura.
The Ishimura was the first Planetcracker-class vessel, and is now the oldest serving, with 62 years of continuous service.
It holds the record for highest number of planetcracks, with 34 to date-
-- and highest deadweight of refined product, at 14 trillion kilotons and counting.

Whether you'll be joining us aboard the Ishimura or strengthening the extraction workforce on the colony, the captain and crew would like to welcome you and we hope your stay is a pleasant one. Concordance Extraction Company - "Powering humanity into the future.

Sorry, Isaac, I couldn't let him go through with it. I suppose I should thank him for finding the Marker. We even managed without help from the USM Valor... Thank you for helping me find it, by the way. My department's been looking for this place for a long time. See, what Kyne didn't know was, it was the government's mess to begin with. This whole planet was one big experiment. The Marker? This "divine relic"? Made by man.  They reverse-engineered it a couple of hundred years ago from the REAL Marker, a true alien artifact recovered on Earth.  They dug it up, studied it, and made it their own. Then they brought it to Aegis 7, and activated it.  And you've seen the result.  The stuff of nightmares.  They sealed the system, and no one would have been the wiser.  But then CEC blunders in and starts tearing the planet apart.  The experiment was still alive.  Kyne was right about the Hive Mind.  The Marker would contain it...but that doesn't matter now, does it?  I have the Marker, and this entire system can go to hell. For what it's worth, you did a great job, Isaac. See you around... Or maybe not.
Isaac, what the hell are you doing?! You're making a big mistake. This is not over!
translation: 아이작,무슨 짓을 하는 거야?! 지금 큰 실수 하는 거야. 이걸로 끝난 게 아니야!

english: Isaac, Isaac... You really didn't  think I was going to just walk away, did you? I can't do that. The Marker's coming with me. It's a shame... I was starting to like you. Even if you are insane. What, you don't believe me? Take a look at yourself. Better yet, take a look at that video from Nicole. And this time, watch it right to the end...
translation: 아이작…내가 정말 그냥 가버릴거라 생각한건 아니지?그럴순 없지.마커를 가져가야 하니까.이를 어쩌나…네가 좋아지기 시작했는데.제정신이 아니긴 하지만.뭐야,모르겠어?자신을 봐.그렇지,니콜의 영상을 보는게 이해가 빠를거야.이번엔 끝까지 잘 보라고…

english: See! You're insane. Just like Kyne, just like the Captain. Nicole has been dead this whole time.  Whatever you were seeing...was caused by that.  You were its pawn. But don't worry.  It will be in good hands, now.  Far away from this damned place. Goodbye, Isaac
translation: 거봐!넌 제정신이 아니지,카인이나 선장처럼.니콜은 처음부터 살아있지도 않았어.봤던게 뭐였든…환상이었어.넌 낚였던 거야.하지만 걱정마.이젠 내 수중에 들어 왔으니까.이 빌어먹을 곳과도 안녕이다.잘있어,아이작.

english: Isaac, that son of a bitch just overrode the door lock!  I'll try to run a bypass.  Hold on!
translation: 아이작,저 개자식이 문을 잠궈 버렸어요! 어떻게든 열어 볼테니 조금만 참아요!

english: Okay, I bypassed the lock!  Get out of there!
Get the hell out of there!
Run Isaac, find a weapon somewhere!
Run Isaac, get to the elevator! Run!
This is Benson. Everybody listen up! They're using the vents! That's how they're getting around the ship! Stay away from the vents...
translation: 여기는 벤슨.명심해!환기구야!이놈들이 거길 이용해 돌아다닌다.환기구에서 떨어져…

english: This is Benson, tram engineering. We think we've figured it out. Smith killed one! Listen, forget about shooting them in the body, you gotta cut off the limbs. Grab a cutter, anything like that. Cut them apart!
translation: 여기는 전동차정비사 벤슨.약점을 찾은것 같다.스미스가 한놈을 죽였어.잘들어.몸뚱아리를 쏘겠다는 생각은 버려.사지를 잘라버려.절단기 같은걸 집어들어,토막내!

english: Listen up, car 8 is trashed.  We managed to get it back to the repair depot, but now the auto-loader is fried.  I need a Stasis module brought down here now!  If we don't get this piece of shit off the tracks, it's going to jam up the whole system!
translation: 주목해라,8번 차가 부서졌다.정비구역으로 가져오긴 했지만 망할 자동운반기가 통닭이 됐다.당장 감속장비를 가져와.선로에서 개떡같은 파편을 못치우면 시스템 전체가 엉망이돼.

english: Isaac, one of the Valor's weapons ripped open in the crash. Those green orbs you see are highly radioactive, and the Valor's airlock has sealed itself.  You're going to have to throw those into space before you can get into the ship.\n
translation: 아이작,충격으로 밸러호 무기 일부가 떨어져 나갔어요.거기 녹색구체들이 고농도 방사능물질이라 밸러호 출입구가 폐쇄됐어요.밖에다 전부 버려야만 들어갈수 있어요.

english: It looks like some of the gravity plating is malfunctioning. Keep an eye out for any kind of distortion effect coming from the floor. It could be dangerous.
translation: 중력막 몇군데가 고장났어요.바닥에서 뭔가 일그러진 기둥이 뿜어져 나오는 부분은 위험하니 조심해요.

english: Isaac, it's Kendra. It looks like the door to the storage room is locked. There should be a key somewhere in the maintenance bay.

There's a failsafe on the processing control door.  It won't open until gravity is restored.  But you can't turn on the gravity until those boulders are cleared from the room.  Maybe you can dump them into that gravity beam with your Kinesis gun.
translation: 처리실 문에는 안전장치가 있어요.중력이 회복되어야만 열리는데 안에 바위들이 있어서 회복시킬수 없어요.유도장비로 전부 중력빔 속에 던져버려요.

english: Isaac, you still need to find the data board to the tram computer. It's in the Maintenance Bay.
Looks like that door is malfunctioning, Isaac.  Try using the Stasis Module you just picked up.
translation: 그 문은 고장난 것 같아요,아이작.방금 얻은 감속장비를 사용하세요.

english: Your Stasis module should be able to help you with that arm mechanism.
You still need to plant the beacon onto the shuttle, Isaac, before you launch the asteroid
The life support system in Sleep Block B has been shut down.  You'll have to find an override nearby to get to the door.
translation: B구역 취침실 생명 유지 장치가 정지됐어요. 문까지 가려면 근처에 있는 해제 장치를 찾아야 돼요.

english: You're close to the chemistry station.  Once you get the chemicals, you're also going to need a DNA sample of the alien tissue.  I'll search the records for one.
translation: 화학연구실이 가까워요.우선 약품을 구하면 외계인의 조직DNA샘플도 필요해요.기록을 찾아볼게요.

english: Isaac, I patched into the deck's security system.  It took some work, but I've got the door to the Maintenance Bay unlocked. The data board should be somewhere inside
translation: 아이작,보안시스템을 수정했어요.일단 관리구역 출입구는 열려있어요.구역안 어딘가에 보드가 있을거에요.

english: The mining sub deck is offline for some reason, Isaac.  I'll see if I can run a bypass.
translation: 무슨 이유인지 채굴구역 보조갑판에 연결이 안돼요,아이작. 다른 방법이 있는 지 알아 볼게요.

english: I've got elevator access to the mining sub deck.  It was a security lockdown, although I don't think it helped them.  Now that you've got the beacon and the key, head over there. It looks like the asteroid is held in place by some gravity tethers.  You'll have to knock those out before you can launch it.

Captain's log, personal. I want to set the record straight. By the time this log is heard, my actions will have been vindicated. I'm a Unitologist. By now, it's probably no secret that we shouldn't be in this star system. Just another illegal mining job for the company... That is until the colony found the Marker. That was when the Church took an interest, and chose me to lead this pilgrimage.

They also ensured many of the mission crew were devout. My primary instruction was to get the Marker up from the colony and on board the ship. Dr. Kyne, the CSO, is an expert on the original Marker and was tasked with deciphering this new one. He says he's making good progress. My decision to quarantine the colony is sound.

They've got some kind of epidemic down there, and I can't allow it to infect the ship. Not with such a precious cargo. Not when we are so close! Planetcrack takes place tomorrow. We'll continue to decipher the Marker, and when we return home, we'll pass all our findings, and the Marker, to the Church. The government isn't going to cover this one up. Altman be praised.

You may have read reports that claim the destruction of a planet can destroy an entire solar system due to the disruption in the gravitation forces that hold each celestial object in orbit. Some of the wilder reports claim this causes the whole system to spin out of control or causes planets to smash into each other. Concerned investors are directed to read the article "The CEC Pledge to the Health of Our Universe" for a detailed breakdown of the truths about Planet Cracking. The short answer is: Planet Cracking is perfectly safe and provides an essential service to Earth and the colonies. With all Planet Cracks, the planets are carefully chosen for their mineral content, net worth, and the safety with which they can be dismantled.\n\n

Planet Cracking is a lengthy process spanning from three to five years. Generally, the first year is spent prospecting and setting up the colony. The second year and a half involves tectonic excavation and related planet-side activities.

The Planet Cracker class ship arrives between the 2.5 and 3 year mark, depending on the progress of the excavation. Once the ship is in orbit, preparation for tectonic chunk extraction begins. This takes approximately one week.

The removal of an excavated chunk from the planet into a stabilized geosynchronous orbit usually takes about 1 day (24 standard hours). During this process, billions of tons of debris break off from the underside of the chunk, creating an instant asteroid ring around the planet. While the floating debris is extremely dangerous, the Planet Cracker ships have an excellent Asteroid Defense System (ADS) to keep the ship and crew safe from harm.

Depending on the size of the planet, this process is repeated until the entire planet has been broken up and processed.

ABOUT US

The CEC is the largest solar mining and extraction company in the Earth colonies. It is also the fifth largest company in terms of market capital. It has become a powerhouse of industrial might and an influential political force. With a generous budget allocated to election spending, CEC has always been able to maintain and improve its market position.

The CEC owns over 400 deep space vehicles including five Planet Crackers, with the famous USG Ishimura as its flagship. The CEC was the first to develop deep space mining, asteroid catchers and was the first to implement shockpoint drives for commercial use. We are the largest supplier of precious metals.

Out of over three dozen Planet Cracks, only one operation has met with less than optimal results. Many may remember the Wanat Disaster 11 years ago wherein a Planet Cracker, three supply ships and a colony were lost due to a gravity tether failure. Since that time, CEC has worked closely with the manufacturers and held crew training lectures to ensure a distaster of this magnitude never happens again.

We take your financial well-being and the well-being of our employees seriously. When you invest in CEC, you are investing in the future of mankind.

What ARE you doing? Your fight for survival is admirable but pointless. And yet you keep on going. It almost makes me think that we had hope, as a species. Am I the only one who sees that we have died out a long time ago? We just haven't accepted it yet. Stop running. Stop your struggle. Our future, your future, the future of our race, ends here. Allow me to introduce you to humanity's child. The children that will replace us. Our greatest creation.

Be glad of the knowledge that your death... will bring their birth!  Listen! Can you hear it? It is coming. Say your prayers.

english: Personal log, Doctor Challus Mercer. The specimen continues to respond well to my experiments. Its cellular fortitude, not to mention elasticity, is remarkable. Doctor Kyne, I am sure, would disapprove. But I do not anticipate that issue, as the good doctor is busying himself with the Marker... As if that matters now! He has also succumbed to the same dementia that afflicted the colony. Only yesterday, he told me he had spoken to his wife... but Amelia Kyne has been dead for some years.
translation: 개인기록.챌러스 머서 박사.표본이 실험에 잘 반응하고 있다.세포의 자생력은 두말할것도 없이 놀랍다.카인 박사는 확실히 불만일 것이야.하지만 거기에 미리 걱정하지는 않는다.그 훌륭하신 박사께서는 마커 일로 바쁘시니까…설사 당장 문제가 되더라도 콜로니인들과 같은 정신착란에 시달리고 있지.바로 어제,자기 아내와 이야기했다고…허나 아멜리아 카인은 몇년전에 죽었다.

english: My subject grows restless. Patience. Your time is soon. Very soon.
translation: 나의 실험체는 쉴새없이 성장하고 있다.참아라.곧 너의 시대다.이제 곧.

english: This has gone far enough! Accept your part in god's plan! Embrace your own extinction!
translation: 이건 도가 지나치군!신의 뜻을 받아 들여라.자신의 소멸을 받아 들여.

english: I'm beginning to truly admire your spirit, misplaced as it may be! I think... I think you should see... The whole plan.  You should not spurn the Hive Mind's offerings.  You deserve to witness that, at least.
translation: 그대의 의지는 존경스럽군.잘못된 곳에 있지만 말야.아마도…내 생각에…모든 계획을 아는 건가…하이브 마인드의 선물을 거부해선 안돼.적어도 그대는 지켜볼 자격이 있어.

These specimens will return to Earth with me. I will spread their divine glory across the entire planet! I'll leave you with my creation.  Embrace the inevitable.

english: Can't you see, god's plan is unfolding, and we are its inheritors! We will ascend, as we always knew we would! UNITOLOGY IS TRUTH! And your death is the first phase of this transformation.
translation: 보이지 않는가,신의 계획이 펼쳐졌다.우리가 그 후계자들이다!항상 그래 왔듯 우리는 진화하리라!유니톨로지가 진리다!그대들의 죽음이 이 변화의 첫걸음이다.

translation: 육체의 변화에 단념은 금물이다.이내 육체에 대한 중시를 초월할테니!필연적 과정임을 믿어야만 한다.

english: Where are you going? You fools! This is what we've been searching for all these years! This is what we have been waiting for. Don't listen to them! Come back! COME BACK!!!
translation: 어디로 가는가?멍청한 놈들!이거야 말로 우리가 그토록 찾던 것이다.우리가 그토록 기다리던 것이다.그놈들 말은 듣지마! 돌아와라,돌아와!
